For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Generative AI Engineer to help build and maintain APIs and SDKs to train, fine-tune and access AI models at scale. You will work as part of our Enterprise AI team and build systems that will enable our users to work with Large-Language Models (LLMs) and Foundation Models (FMs), using our public cloud infrastructure. You will work with a team of world-class AI engineers and researchers to design and implement key API products and services that enable real-time customer-facing applications. • Architect, build and deploy well-managed core APIs and SDKs to access LLMs and our proprietary FMs including training, fine-tuning and prompting tasks, including orchestration SDKs.
• Design APIs for performance, real-time applications, scale, ease of use and governance automation.
• Develop application-specific interfaces that leverage LLMs and FMs to continue to enhance the associate and customer experience.
• Enable our users to build new GenAI capabilities.
• Develop tools and processes to monitor API access patterns and operational health.
• Design and implement AI safety and guardrails in the API layer working closely with researchers.

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity

• Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a technical field
• At least 4 years of experience designing and building and deploying ML application platforms.
• At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java
• At least 1 year of experience building, scaling, and optimizing training or inferencing systems for deep neural networks

• Familiarity with building large-scale AI products or platforms for NLP, speech, computer vision, or recommendation systems serving millions of users.

• Familiarity with graph querying tools such as Apache Tinkerpop Gremlin, Apache Spark Graphframes, or graph databases.

Job Title
AI and Data Portfolio Lead

Job Description Summary
The AI and Data Portfolio Lead is part of the global TDS PMO organization and reports into the Head of the Technology PMO. The AI and data portfolio lead will be responsible for overseeing the development and delivery of AI and data solutions across our organization. You will work closely with other senior leaders to define the vision, strategy, governance and roadmap for AI and data initiatives. This role is also responsible for managing and mentoring a team of project professionals to deliver the technology programs and projects. This is a player-coach role, and therefore the Portfolio Lead may also manage specific major projects as assigned.

Job Description

Candidate Background

The ideal candidate will have experience in setting up and leading a data-driven organization or transforming an existing organization into a data-driven one. A critical success factor for this role is the ability to strategically align data and AI projects with Cushman & Wakefield’s long-term goals. This includes a keen understanding of emerging technologies and market trends, the capacity to prioritize initiatives based on value generation and risk assessment, and the skill to foster collaboration among cross-functional teams to drive innovation and efficiency. Effective communication and stakeholder management are also essential to ensure that the portfolio advances the organization's objectives and delivers tangible benefits.

The Portfolio Lead will have significant experience with proven ability of operating effectively in a global organization, managing complex programs, and a background of managing effectively within a structured portfolio environment. Experience building and continually improving portfolio governance processes and tools is a plus. The right candidate will have exceptional executive communication skills, proven experience identifying interdependencies and potential collisions across a broad program landscape, and keeping teams continually focused on delivery against a defined scope.

Job Description (summary of the role purpose):
• Portfolio governance and management: The portfolio lead ensures that all projects follow the appropriate governance, methodologies, processes, and standards. They also plan, schedule, and manage the resources and dependencies for the portfolio. 
• Reporting and analytics: The portfolio lead provides regular reports on the portfolio, program, and project status, resource demand, and financials. They use the standards set by the C&W enterprise PMO. 
• Collaboration and partnership: The portfolio lead collaborates with change management, communications, and cross-functional teams to implement solutions. They also partner with key stakeholders and leaders across the business and within TDS to deliver strategic outcomes. They manage relationships and negotiate where applicable. 
• Risk and issue management: The portfolio lead is responsible for ensuring that operational risks and issues are considered and reported during the design, development, and implementation of projects. They also identify and mitigate common or significant risks impacting the portfolio. 
• Quality Management: Ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of AI and data solutions, as well as compliance with data privacy, security, and ethical standards are signed off/adhered to.
• Mentoring and coaching: The portfolio lead is responsible for mentoring more junior members of the team, providing guidance and direction to ensure the team's success. 
• Governance and decision making: The portfolio lead sets up and participates in governance boards, steering committees, and roadmap discussions to guide decision making on project sequencing, dependencies, and conflicts. They also provide oversight on feasibility studies, systems roadmaps, and business cases. Develop best practices to accelerate AI and Data solution development.

Responsibilities:

Responsibilities may vary within the range of tasks and activities described, with specific objectives being set, documented, and reviewed by the Head of PMO

Portfolio Management:
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive roadmap and portfolio of the organisation's AI and data projects and products, aligning them with the organisation's strategic goals and priorities.
• Support operating model design, suggesting and implementing improvements
• Collaborate with leadership to define and prioritize projects in the portfolio.
• Manage and execute planning, scheduling, resource requirements and dependencies for the portfolio
• Utilize project management tools and methodologies to monitor and control project activities for all projects in the portfolio, tracking project progress, milestones, and deliverables.
• Provide reporting and analytics including Portfolio, Program and Project Status, and Resource Demand Management.
• Manage and report risks and issues to projects in the portfolio.
• Report Portfolio financials including budget, forecast and actuals.
• Produce regular Portfolio status reports using standard documentation and tools, ensuring inclusion of timely and accurate information.
• Manage interdependencies with other projects or programs both within and outside the portfolio.
• Manage relationships with key owners across TDS and within individual functions, business units.
• Manage relationships with a variety of stakeholders to influence and negotiate where applicable.
• Manage relationships with strategic vendor partners.
• Manage and Chair Portfolio meetings as required.
• Remove or mitigate barriers to success.
• Contribute to defining PMO governance and methodology and ensure adherence with project teams.
• Participate in COE and roadmap discussions, suggest improvements.
• Partner with change management team to ensure alignment of any change, training and comms plans

Project Management (as applicable):
• Build and maintain detailed project plans – including dependencies and critical path management.
• Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, managing their expectations, and ensuring clear and effective communication throughout the project lifecycle.
• Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize their impact on the project. Proactively manage issues as they arise to keep the project on track.
• Manage changes to project scope, schedule, and costs. Evaluate the impact of changes and communicate adjustments to stakeholders.
• Maintain project documentation, including reports, schedules, budgets, and other relevant records. Provide regular updates and status reports to stakeholders and leadership.
• Collaborate effectively with change management team, incorporate training and communications, ensuring plans for projects within the portfolio are consistent with the size and profile of the project, and follow a defined framework.
• Ensure operational risks and issues are considered and reported during the design, development and implementation of projects.
• Maintain regular progress meetings and continuity with the relevant business owner(s) and Steering Committees
• Ensure that projects are transitioned to Business as Usual and Operational Support following a formal gate review process.

Qualifications:
• At least 10 years of experience in leading and managing data projects and teams.
• 4-6 years of experience in leading and managing AI projects and teams, preferably in a data-driven environment.
• Blend of experience across business operations and technology, including support of enterprise technology change management.
• Strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate business problems and opportunities into AI and data solutions.
• Leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire, motivate, and develop a diverse and talented team.

Skills & Personal Qualities:
• Excellent written and verbal communication
• Financial acumen
• Highly adept at project and change management
• High level of organization
• Solution oriented problem solver
• Strong prioritization skills
• Analytical and data-driven
• Team Player with strong collaboration skills
• Management and leadership skills
• Self-starter
• Ability to articulate ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Keen attention to detail
• Ability to perform under pressure
• Strategic mindset and ability to envision end state and the milestone activities to achieve

Cushman & Wakefield provides equal employment opportunity. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated. Cushman & Wakefield is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative​ Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position at Cushman & Wakefield, please call the ADA line at 1-888-365-5406 or email HRServices@cushwake.com. Please refer to the job title and job location when you contact us.

Number of Openings: 2

Salary Range: $70,000 - $110,000 (Please see below for more info on salary)

AI/ML Developer

SimVentions is a 100% employee-owned business and has consistently been voted one of Virginia's Best Places to Work. We are actively seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer with interest in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to join our innovative development team. As a pivotal member of our organization, you will be at the forefront of architecting, developing, and optimizing cutting-edge software solutions that harness the power of AI and ML technologies. In this role, you will contribute significantly to the advancement of our products, pushing the boundaries of what is possible in the dynamic and evolving field of AI/ML.

As a Software Engineer with AI/ML interest, you will play a critical role in crafting the underlying software infrastructure for sophisticated machine learning algorithms. Your contribution will extend beyond the realm of AI, encompassing the full spectrum of software development. From designing scalable architecture to writing efficient and maintainable code, you will be a key player in delivering high-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate will have a thorough experience of developing innovative solutions in sensor processing and AI, delivering product-quality software, with provable track record of open-source software contributions and experience solving a wide range of complex sensor processing problems in various domains. Knowledge of NVIDIA Holoscan platform is a definite bonus.

Responsibilities:
• NVIDIA Holoscan is the sensor processing platform that streamlines the development and deployment of AI and HPC applications.
• AI/ML Solution Development:
- Design, develop, and implement robust frameworks for AI/ML algorithms and models to solve complex business problems.
- Develop CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment of containerized applications.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI/ML components into software applications and systems.
• Software Development:
- Contribute to the full software development life cycle, from requirements analysis to design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
- Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code while adhering to coding standards and best practices.
- Develop high-quality, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to coding standards and best practices.
- Contribute to the development of software architecture, ensuring scalability, modularity, and extensibility.
• Performance Optimization:
- Optimize and enhance existing AI/ML frameworks for improved efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
- Conduct thorough performance analysis and implement optimizations to meet specified performance goals.
• Collaboration and Documentation:
- Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to understand project requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
- Document code, algorithms, and processes to facilitate knowledge sharing and maintain comprehensive project documentation.

Requirements:
• United States Citizenship
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
• Understanding of machine learning algorithms, data structures, and statistical models.
• Familiarity with software development tools, version control systems, and agile methodologies.
• Problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.

Preferred Skills & Experience:
• Proven experience in software development with a focus on AI/ML applications.
• Experience with popular ML frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
• Database development and use for machine learning and big data applications

Education:A Bachelor of Science (BS) degree from an accredited college or university in an engineering, scientific, or technical discipline is required

Clearance: A Secret Clearance is required for this position. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. US Citizenship is required to obtain a clearance.

Travel: Occasional local on site meetings will be required.

Benefits & Compensation: At SimVentions, we’re committed to supporting the total well-being of our employees and their families. Our benefit offerings include comprehensive health and welfare plans to serve a variety of needs.

We offer:
• Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage
• Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
• Competitive 401(k) programs
• Retirement and Financial Counselors
• Health Savings and Health Reimbursement Accounts
• Flexible Spending Accounts
• Life insurance, short- & long-term disability
• Continuing Education Assistance
• Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Paid Leave (e.g., Maternity, Paternity, Jury Duty, Bereavement, Military)
• Third Party Employee Assistance Program that offers emotional and lifestyle well-being services, to include free counseling
• Supplemental Benefit Program

Compensation at SimVentions is determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, security clearance, work location, skills, knowledge, and competencies, as well as alignment with our corporate compensation plan and contract specific requirements.

The projected annual compensation range for this position is $70,000 - $110,000 (USD). This estimate reflects the standard salary range for this position and is just one component of the total compensation package that SimVentions offers.
Why Work for SimVentions?

SimVentions is about more than just being a place to work with other growth-orientated technically exceptional experts. It’s also a fun place to work. Our family-friendly atmosphere encourages our employee-owners to imagine, create, explore, discover, and do great things together.

Support Our Warfighters

SimVentions is a proud supporter of the U.S. military, and we take pride in our ability to provide relevant, game-changing solutions to our armed men and women around the world.

Drive Customer Success

We deliver innovative products and solutions that go beyond the expected. This means you can expect to work with a team that will allow you to grow, have a voice, and make an impact.

Get Involved in Giving Back

We believe that one of the best ways to be a well-rounded company is to have well-rounded employees, and one of the ways we encourage that is by providing a wide range of service opportunities for our team members to engage in throughout the year.

Build Innovative Technology

SimVentions takes pride in its innovative and cutting-edge technology, so you can be sure that whatever project you work on, you will be having a direct impact on our customer’s success.

Work with Brilliant People

At SimVentions, we don’t just hire the smartest people. We hire experienced, creative individuals who are passionate about what they do, and who benefit from the culture that we have created here.

Create Meaningful Solutions

We are trusted partners with our customers and are provided challenging and meaningful requirements to help them solve.

Employees who join SimVentions will enjoy benefits like:
• Impact: work on projects that directly support the defense of our nation.
• Serve: work for a company that supports its surrounding communities.
• Employee Owned: work with the best and help build YOUR company.
• Dress code: business casual. We like to be comfortable while we work.
• Healthcare: one of the best packages in the industry.
• Culture: add to our culture of technical excellence and collaboration.
• Food: we have a lot of food around here.

The Systems Management Analyst must have knowledge of managing a virtual desktop environment, operating systems and deployment, systems management and patch management applications, and storage technologies. They will be a hands-on resource responsible for being the primary support of our company’s VDI solution, as well as assisting the Enterprise Infrastructure team with the management of end devices. As part of the Enterprise Infrastructure team this individual will assist in new project initiatives, device deployments, and infrastructure management.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
• Work with stakeholders to identify business needs and translate to technical solutions
• Balance break/fix work and project work to help drive key Enterprise Infrastructure objectives
• Open and effective collaboration between Enterprise Infrastructure and Information Security teams to ensure technical solutions meet security, regulatory, and compliance requirements
• Design, implement, and maintain virtual desktop infrastructure solutions based on business requirements. This includes selecting appropriate virtualization technologies and hardware components for optimal performance and scalability.
• Monitor and optimize the performance of VDI environments, including resource utilization, network latency, cost optimization, and user experience.
• Diagnosing and resolving issues related to VDI infrastructure, virtual desktops, and associated components. Providing technical support to end-users and guiding IT staff as needed.
• Forecasting future technical resource requirements and scaling VDI environments accordingly to accommodate growth and changes in workload demands.
• Support VMware Workspace ONE environment, including configuration, policy management, application deployment, and user provisioning. Ensure seamless integration with VDI infrastructure and endpoint devices.
• Configure and manage endpoint devices using Tanium, ensuring security, compliance, and optimal performance.
• Implement and enforce endpoint management policies and configurations to protect against security threats and vulnerabilities.
• Experience with creating, managing, and deploying standardized desktop images using Microsoft tools (ex: Microsoft Deployment Toolkit, System Center Configuration Manager, etc.).
• Implement and maintain patch management processes for virtual desktops and endpoint devices. Ensure timely deployment of security patches and updates to protect against vulnerabilities and compliance risks.
• Develop and deliver training materials and sessions to educate end-users on best practices and usage guidelines.
• Maintain accurate documentation of VDI configurations, endpoint management policies, and troubleshooting procedures. Generate reports on VDI performance, endpoint compliance, and patch management status as needed.
• Collaborating with other IT teams, such as security and engineering, to ensure seamless integration of endpoint management and VDI solutions with existing infrastructure and services.

REQUIREMENTS
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Proven experience in designing, deploying, and managing virtual desktop infrastructure solutions, using VMware Horizon, Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Microsoft Remote Desktop Services, or similar technologies.
• Excellent troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
• Expertise in VMware Workspace ONE administration (or similar technologies such as JAMF, Intune, etc.) including configuration, policy management, patch management, and application deployment.
• Hands-on experience with Tanium endpoint management platform (or similar), including configuration management, patch management, and security enforcement.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Deployment Toolkit (MDT) (or similar) for image deployment, patch management, and software distribution.
• Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell) for automation and task automation within VDI and endpoint management environments.
• Broad experience and knowledge of Windows Server and Linux operating systems.
• Experience using a service desk ticketing system.

Education/Certification:
• BS/BA degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or 5+ years in related experience
• Certifications in one or more of the following are preferred: Microsoft, ITIL, VMware

Experience:
• 5+ years of related work experience in enterprise architecture / technical operations
• 5+ years of experience working with cross-functional teams and heavily matrixed organizations

About Blitzy

Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based Seed Stage Generative AI start-up. We are on a mission to automate software creation to unlock the next industrial revolution.

We have happy paying customers, backing from multiple tier 1 investors, success as founders at the last start-up, and dozens of Generative AI patents to our names.

Location: One Kendall Square, Cambridge MA 02139 (In-person role)

Compensation: $65,000 per year, Flexible Start date

Overview

About the role

We’re looking for a great writer and visual storyteller to own the creation of our video content for our social platforms.

AI and business news isn’t always the most exciting thing, we get that. That’s where you come in! Your job is to pique the interest of our audience on things like how Gen AI could affect niche area's of the lending industry to 'what's real vs hype' in AI software tooling.

You need to be in the know (or be willing to be in the know) about everything that goes on in the world of business and AI news.

The next step is to take all that boring information and turn it into an engaging piece of video content. Straight to camera reporting is good, but you know what’s even better, a sketch explainer breaking down the how many times Liberty Mutual mentioned AI in it's latest report to Wall Street, and what they're actually saying behind all the business jargon . Basically, concepts and visuals are just as important as the story and writing itself.

You will also be capturing behind the scenes content of the Founders and company, capturing and telling the story behind the start-up as it's growing. Finally, you will be producing video style content between the founders and AI thought leaders in Boston, including MIT/Harvard Professors, Investors, and Start-up Leaders

If this endeavor sounds energizing, then keep on reading.

Here's What You'll Be Working On
• Pitch stories and concepts surrounding the world of business and AI, with an emphasis on software creation using AI and the effect AI has on legacy industries including finance, insurance and real estate.
• Research and write scripts for social videos.
• Shoot content (we’ll give you all the tools you need) .
• Edit and produce the final product or send an editing direction to our marketing agency to finish the product.
• Collaborate with our marketing agency to deliver content in line with our content pillars and social calendar

Need to Have
• Experience in creating video content for social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, X, and other
• Ability to write scripts in an engaging, informative, and clever style
• Experience using the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere Pro, not After Effects BUT it would be a nice have)
• Self-starter attitude (can create a video from start-to-finish), with the ability to operate in a collaborative environment.
• Ability to operate in a high-pressure and fast paced environment (AI advancements move quick!)
• Baseline understanding and eagerness to continually learn about Gen AI, business, and how they intersect.
• Located in Boston/Cambridge, MA Area

You’ll Get...
• Paid Compensation
• Equity
• Exceptional Health Care, Vision, and Dental Insurance for you and any dependents
• 401(K) with match
• Opportunity to work daily with Founders
• Beautiful office environment with adjacent offices shared by other start-ups. It’s an energizing community.
• Any content creation equipment you need!
• Unlimited snacks, seltzer water, coffee and whatever else you need to be at your best.

Culture

Who we are: Our founding team is composed of a Serial Gen. AI Inventor and a Serial Entrepreneur (Harvard SEAS and HBS Alum). We work hard, have a curious mind-set, and believe in a low-ego high output approach.

We love to move fast on all ‘two-way door’ decisions. A good decision made today is better than a ‘perfect’ decision in 1 week.

We believe in the importance of being an ‘everyday athlete’ so you can bring your best mind to work. We promote getting great sleep, motion/movement in daily, along with whatever other type of restorative activity gets you to optimal mental performance. It makes for a happier and more productive team.

More tactically, we leave the office in time to have dinner at home with our families nearly every night.

What We Ask Of You

Please ask yourself if you are ready for a challenge before applying. Even in optimal conditions, start-ups are hard, and are always a lot of work. What you do week to week may change. If this feels exciting, not concerning, that’s a good sign.

Start-ups also require a lot of autonomy. We will be in person, and we have relevant experience, but we do not have all the answers. Like every start-up, we continue to discover as we build. If this is exciting, please reach out.

To apply

Please apply through this Job Posting.

Process

The process can be scheduled and completed quickly. Please share your website portfolio within the website field as a part of the application. Here’s what you can expect for the process.
• 15-minute intro phone call
• Remote Practical Exercise
• 30-minute In person interview
• Notification of offer with timeline to accept

We are hiring a Learning and Development Program Manager to move our learning faster into the future. This role reports into Global Head of Learning for the organization and will closely align with the Director of Digital Upskilling and Change from the Technology & Data Solutions team.
This key hire to our team will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and evaluating learning programs focused on increasing the capability of our employees to embrace artificial intelligence (AI), GenAI and the productivity enhancements created by these fast-moving new technologies.

• Conduct thorough needs assessments to identify learning gaps and performance improvement opportunities related to AI and productivity.
• Collaborate with Business Leaders, Technology Partners and the People team to understand specific learning requirements.

• Design and develop innovative learning programs tailored to AI technologies, tools, and productivity enhancement. These initiatives may vary from highly technical in nature to behavior change learning concepts.
• Create engaging content that can be delivered in multi-modal formats including e-learning modules, workshops, and instructor-led sessions.
• Incorporate adult learning principles and best practices into program design.
• Training Delivery:
• Facilitate training sessions, both in-person and virtually, to educate employees on AI concepts, tools, and productivity strategies.
• Adapt training methods to accommodate different learning styles and preferences.
• Evaluation and Continuous Improvement:
• Measure the effectiveness of training programs through assessments, feedback, and performance metrics.
• Continuously improve content based on learner feedback and emerging trends in AI and productivity.
• Collaboration:
• Partner with internal teams to align learning initiatives with business goals.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.
• Be a coach to global L&D team members on increasing their own knowledge of the new capabilities afforded by Gen AI in creation, curation and management of learning programs.

• Develop, implement and maintain a set of clear, measurable eLearning outcomes for each program created. Capture accurate records of learning activities and participant feedback
• Generate reports to track program impact and ROI.

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in instructional design, training, or learning and development.
• Proven and documented understanding of AI concepts, machine learning, and productivity tools.
• Outstanding verbal and written communication, executive presence, interpersonal skills, facilitation and collaboration skills.
• Experience working effectively with all levels of management, including top executive level and administrative personnel with a commitment to inclusion, equity, diversity, continuous improvement, a passion for people and openness to new ideas and perspectives.

• Growth mindset and passionate about creating exceptional learning experiences.
• Effective organization, project-management, time-management, and self-management skills with detail orientation.
• Experience and comfort facilitating high-impact learning sessions.
• Experience working independently and effectively in a globally dispersed team environment/matrixed organization with a broad cross-section of people.

Description

Who is Defined.ai? Well, from a technical point of view, we leverage the power of a global crowd to provide some of the world’s biggest companies with the high-quality data they need to power their artificial intelligence. We’re instrumental to the progression and development of artificial intelligence and we couldn’t be prouder or more inspired to be involved in an industry that is changing the world.

From a personal point of view, we’re a group of big thinkers, high achievers and creative problem solvers. We bond over our shared love of software engineering, data science, and strong coffee. We like online gaming, running marathons, and team drinks. We celebrate authenticity and diversity and we’re invested in what we do. Our mission? World domination, obviously!

What you'll do:
• You will create organic revenue streams working with the solutions and customer success teams within assigned territories/regions.
• Manage the end-to-end customer journey from inception to delivery, aligned with sales strategy.
• Contribute to the Sales team, developing new customer acquisition strategies and development of processes across different product streams.
• Manage enterprise and or strategic customers with significant deal sizes $500k-$5M.
• Support and collaborate with internal partners to build successful proof of concepts, use cases and RFPs etc.

Requirements
• 6+ years of proven multi-country experience working in Technical Sales and or similar experience working within Enterprise / Professional Services / Data / Customized Projects / Consultative Sales.
• Proven sales executive experience, meeting or exceeding targets.
• Proficient on tools optimisation: Salesforce / CRM and MS Office.
• Strong ownership of workforce planning, hiring, sales pipeline setup and control and finance basics.
• Ability to communicate, present and influence all levels of the organization, including executives.
• Strong ability to handle directly and close complex deals above $1M.
• Able to analyse high value potential customers and within assigned verticals
• Strong ability to negotiate and close high value deals
• Proven ability to drive the sales process from plan to close
• Demonstrable ability to articulate the distinct aspects of products and services
• Proven ability to position products against competitors and showcase value proposition
• Demonstrable experience as head of sales, developing client-focused, differentiated and achievable solutions
• Knowledge in AI/ML.
• Bachelor's degree and or equivalent. We value a Computer Science / Engineering background.

Benefits

You spend a lot of your time at work, so it should be challenging, fun and interesting. At Defined.ai it will be all of those things and more. Here’s what we offer:
• Flexible working schedule and hybrid model. We know comfort can boost creativity and performance, so you can manage your schedule and work both from one of our modern office spaces or home.
• Excellent career development opportunities in a high growth company. With us, you can accomplish your career goals and follow a well-described career path with the support of your supervisor.
• Culture of feedback and continuous improvement. AI is a fast-paced area, so we keep track of tech trends, and we always ask for feedback.
• An international and diverse team. We have more than 30 nationalities at our 4 locations, and we provide language classes.
• Continuous training opportunities. You can choose from many options: leveraging hand-on workshops, unlimited access to Udemy and formal development opportunities.
• We love to have fun together. We joke a lot, and we can't imagine work without fun activities – we already surfed, raced carts and played soccer together.

About Us

Defined.ai offers a platform with multiple data delivery options that leverages machine learning technology and human intelligence to deliver quality-guaranteed training data for AI systems. The platform offers self-service and fully customizable solutions that deliver high-quality project-specific training data, enabling AI products reach market quicker. It is this business model that has allowed Defined.ai to raise a total of $63.6M in funding over 4 rounds. Our value proposition is quality, privacy, speed and scale, covering more than 50 different languages. With strong expertise in speech and natural language processing technologies, we have been serving AI companies and Fortune 500 companies since day one. Defined.ai was founded in Seattle and has offices in Lisbon, Porto and Tokyo.

Your leadership will not only drive advancements in AI but also help shape the future of legal services to maximize impact for our clients. This position offers the rare opportunity to blend technical prowess with strategic foresight, making a tangible difference in our firm and the industry at large.

• Lead and expand the strategic vision for deploying AI and advanced analytics within our firm, translating cutting-edge technology into practical, impactful legal solutions.

• Oversee the development and implementation of proof-of-concepts and AI model deployment, ensuring seamless integration and value creation within our legal framework.
• Be the vanguard for a culture of continuous learning and knowledge exchange within the AI and Data Science Center of Excellence (COE), promoting cross-team collaboration and innovation.
• Offer strategic insights and leadership on the long-term implications, risks, and ethical considerations of AI and advanced analytics in the legal sector.

• Bachelor s degree in a relevant field is required, and an advanced degree or relevant certifications are highly preferred.
• Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in AI, data science, or related fields, with a proven track record in professional services industries.
• Exceptional leadership skills, with experience in building, mentoring, and guiding high-performing, diverse teams of data scientists and AI professionals.
• Demonstrated success in developing and deploying AI-driven solutions and models, particularly within the legal or professional services sectors.
• Profound understanding of AI and advanced analytics technologies, coupled with the ability to discern their feasibility and long-term impact within the legal context.
• Exemplary communication and stakeholder management skills, adept at engaging with leadership and key stakeholders to drive consensus and action.
• A pioneering spirit, driven by a passion to enact change and deliver results in the legal field, balanced with a deep understanding of the associated long-term risks and ethical considerations.

• Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik for deriving actionable insights from data.

• Keen interest and understanding of emerging technologies in AI, such as natural language processing, computer vision, and predictive analytics, to stay ahead in the field.

At ServiceNow, our technology makes the world work for everyone, and our people make it possible. We move fast because the world can’t wait, and we innovate in ways no one else can for our customers and communities. By joining ServiceNow, you are part of an ambitious team of change makers who have a restless curiosity and a drive for ingenuity. We know that your best work happens when you live your best life and share your unique talents, so we do everything we can to make that possible. We dream big together, supporting each other to make our individual and collective dreams come true. The future is ours, and it starts with you.

With more than 7,700+ customers, we serve approximately 85% of the Fortune 500®, and we're proud to be one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® and World's Most Admired Companies™.

Learn more on Life at Now blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at ServiceNow.

Unsure if you meet all the qualifications of a job description but are deeply excited about the role? We still encourage you to apply! At ServiceNow, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all voices are heard, valued, and respected. We welcome all candidates, including individuals from non-traditional, varied backgrounds, that might not come from a typical path connected to this role. We believe skills and experience are transferrable, and the desire to dream big makes for great candidates.
Job Description

Job Description: Business Development Manager - Gen AI

Reports to: Global Gen AI Business Development Leader

Solution Sales is on a journey to innovate across ServiceNow’s go-to-market (GTM), delight our customers, and fuel our unparalleled climb to $16B. ServiceNow’s unique positioning to drive exponential productivity with Gen AI is accelerating our climb! With this rapid scale and dynamic growth we’re hiring Business Development Managers to capture this generational moment and uncork the Gen AI business.

As a Business Development Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping sales leadership define, shape and execute Gen AI strategies within their business. You will help role out initiatives that contribute to market success of ServiceNow's GenAI products and will work closely with Major Area leadership to define and execute Go-To-Market (GTM) priorities for Gen AI across all elements of the integrated ServiceNow Platform.

In this role, you will drive cross-functional collaboration to execute strategic initiatives, help uplevel Gen AI proficiencies of the core team and engage with key pursuits and Accounts. This role requires a seasoned professional with sales leadership, business development, strategy and operations expertise. The candidate must be able to combine Gen AI domain expertise with sales execution excellence to quickly drive action and deliver measurable results.

Successful candidates must be self-starters with a consistent track record of exceeding quota in a fast-paced sales environment, especially for new and incubating technologies. They will have superb leadership skills, high level of integrity, coaching acumen, strong executive presence and communication skills, and a passion for winning as a team. They will exemplify the “Hungry and Humble” ServiceNow mantra to extend the reach and influence of our field teams.

What you get to do in this role:
• Develop and execute growth strategies at regional level in conjunction with adjacent functional leaders (Field Sales and Pre-Sales Leadership, Marketing, Alliances & Channels, Professional Services and Sales Operations teams) to effectively scale our Gen AI business.
• Collaborate closely with Major Area leadership to align priorities and business objectives. Help build, manage and report on the Gen AI forecast and pipeline.
• Contribute to a high powered global team of Gen AI BDM specialists by sharing best practices and supporting your teammates.
• Partner with our Partner and Channel organization to build a sell to, with and through model for Gen AI in your territory.
• Monitor industry developments, competitor activities, emerging trends, potential business opportunities, and customer requirements to provide feedback and insights that inform product managers and leadership.
• Help coach the core teams with deep Gen AI expertise to identify specialty solution opportunities and help manage the sales cycle. 
• Partner cross-functionally to design, build and execute the Gen AI sales growth strategy across all product workflows and all sales geographies.
• Establish & drive sales best practices across the organization including reference accounts, demand gen activities, repeatable sales plays, enablement and partner activation.
• Be a trusted advisor and leader across the team, be a go-to expert for EBCs, and a respected presenter in sales and market conferences.
• Engage directly with customers at C-level to champion large deals and ensure success.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, we need someone who has:
• Strong proficiency with Gen AI sales as a Sales, SC or practitioner of Gen AI capabilities. Specialist sales experience is a plus. Deep Gen AI and Automation solution experience is a must.
• 10+ years experience in technical consultative selling, account management, or sales strategy roles.
• Sales experience in large, global software companies (2,000+ employees); skilled at operating in a matrixed sales environment.
• Strong experience managing multi-tiered customer relationships, selling to large customers and establishing relationships at the C-suite level.
• A consistent track record of meeting and exceeding team quotas.
• Superior knowledge and demonstrated skills of sales techniques, customer interaction, customer relations.
• Strong organization, communication, teamwork, presentation, problem solving and time management skills. 
• Proven track record in business development and strategic planning with VP level leadership
• The ability to navigate and collaborate through complex opportunities. 
• A winning, can do attitude, strong work ethic, humility and excellent team building communication and listening skills. 
• The willingness and ability to travel 50% of the time.  

For positions in New York City, we offer a base pay of $183,330 - $302,470, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs.  Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Additional Information

ServiceNow is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status or any other category protected by law.

At ServiceNow, we lead with flexibility and trust in our distributed world of work. Click here to learn about our work personas: flexible, remote and required-in-office.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us at talent.acquisition@servicenow.com for assistance.

All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by the U.S. Government.

job_description:
Bring your heart to CVS Health. Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand - with heart at its center - our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver.

Our Heart At Work Behaviors support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient and affordable.

Position Summary

The Aetna IT Delivery organization, within CVS Health's Data, Digital, Analytics, Technology (DDAT) organization, is seeking a Conversational AI Delivery Lead to drive the overall user experience for a Conversational AI platform that is helping our members to get answers to their health insurance questions through the channel of their choice. In this role you will be responsible for leading the design and implementation of the overall user experience. This role is responsible for the big picture thinking, strategic direction, presenting to key stakeholders and holding engineering teams accountable for overarching delivery goals.

You will make an impact by:
• Providing technical leadership and mentorship to a team of engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including product owners, designers, business stakeholders, and engineers to drive key initiatives, projects, as well as bringing innovative ideas and concepts to life, facilitating a culture of experimentation.
• Designing and architecting robust conversational AI solutions that deliver a seamless user experience across channels.
• Evaluating and selecting the most suitable technologies and tools to optimize chat solutions with an emphasis on leveraging advanced techniques such as AI, Machine Learning and Cloud Native platforms.
• Researches and proposes technical strategies. Studies and documents architectural frameworks and reference material. Designs and modifies components of new and existing IT systems and vendor offerings to promote integrated corporate business systems.
• Driving continuous improvement in engineering practices, through automation, performance optimization, and code quality enhancements.
• Embodying a deep technical expertise and thought leadership that will help evangelize, foster and accelerate adoption of conversational solutions.
• Explores, anticipates, and proactively responds to future customer, industry, and IT trends.
• The successful candidate will have a strong work ethic, be a self-starter, and able to be highly productive in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

Required Qualifications
• The ideal candidate will have the following experience / knowledge / ability:
• Ability to work Hybrid Model (in office Tuesday / Wednesday / Thursday)
• 12+ years of experience in software development, enterprise architecture, or a similar role.
• 5+ years if experience with AI development tools
• 5+ Years of experience in Python or Java
• 5+ years in AI framework libraries and AI tooling platforms
• 5+ AWS, Azure or GCP
• 5+ years of experience with developing and implementing target architectures.
• Proven track record of designing and implementing conversational AI solutions, preferably in a large-scale enterprise environment.
• Strong knowledge of cloud computing, SaaS architectures, and modern technologies such as machine learning and AI.
• Prior experience with large healthcare, media, and entertainment or technology company.
• Knowledge of API interfaces required to support conversational dialog
• Experience with scaled agile (SAFe) methodology

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience building multi-channel conversational bots with Watson Assistant (voice and text as primary channels including Watson Assistant with Phone Integration)
• Knowledge of IBM SaaS services supporting Watson Assistant (speech-to-text, text-to-speech)
• Experience with Miro, LucidChart, Visio dialogue flow development

Education
Bachelor's degree Computer Science, Software Engineering or Information Technology or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$144,200.00 - $288,400.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company's equity award program.

In addition to your compensation, enjoy the rewards of an organization that puts our heart into caring for our colleagues and our communities. The Company offers a full range of medical, dental, and vision benefits. Eligible employees may enroll in the Company's 401(k) retirement savings plan, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan is also available for eligible employees. The Company provides a fully-paid term life insurance plan to eligible employees, and short-term and long term disability benefits. CVS Health also offers numerous well-being programs, education assistance, free development courses, a CVS store discount, and discount programs with participating partners. As for time off, Company employees enjoy Paid Time Off ("PTO") or vacation pay, as well as paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Number of paid holidays, sick time and other time off are provided consistent with relevant state law and Company policies.

For more detailed information on available benefits, please visit jobs.CVSHealth.com/benefits

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/31/2024

job_description:
• We are unable to sponsor for this permanent Full time role*
• Position is bonus eligible*

Prestigious Global Firm is currently seeking a Director of Applied AI and Data Science. Candidate will orchestrate a new era of innovation and impact at the crossroads of technology and law. Candidate will not only drive advancements in AI but also help shape the future of legal services to maximize impact for our clients. This position offers the rare opportunity to blend technical prowess with strategic foresight, making a tangible difference in our firm and the industry at large.

Responsibilities:
• Lead and expand the strategic vision for deploying AI and advanced analytics within our firm, translating cutting-edge technology into practical, impactful legal solutions.
• Champion the identification, assessment, and prioritization of AI/advanced analytics use cases to revolutionize both our legal practices and business operations.
• Cultivate a high-caliber, cross-functional team of data scientists and responsible AI specialists, fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and ethical AI.
• Drive collaboration across a diverse set of stakeholders through a unique hub and spoke model, ensuring the alignment of technology initiatives with business objectives.
• Oversee the development and implementation of proof-of-concepts and AI model deployment, ensuring seamless integration and value creation within our legal framework.
• Be the vanguard for a culture of continuous learning and knowledge exchange within the AI and Data Science Center of Excellence (COE), promoting cross-team collaboration and innovation.
• Offer strategic insights and leadership on the long-term implications, risks, and ethical considerations of AI and advanced analytics in the legal sector.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is required, and an advanced degree or relevant certifications are highly preferred.
• Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in AI, data science, or related fields, with a proven track record in professional services industries.
• Exceptional leadership skills, with experience in building, mentoring, and guiding high-performing, diverse teams of data scientists and AI professionals.
• Demonstrated success in developing and deploying AI-driven solutions and models, particularly within the legal or professional services sectors.
• Profound understanding of AI and advanced analytics technologies, coupled with the ability to discern their feasibility and long-term impact within the legal context.
• Exemplary communication and stakeholder management skills, adept at engaging with leadership and key stakeholders to drive consensus and action.
• A pioneering spirit, driven by a passion to enact change and deliver results in the legal field, balanced with a deep understanding of the associated long-term risks and ethical considerations.

Technologies:
• AI/ML Frameworks and Tools:
• Expertise in popular machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras.
• Proficient in using AI/ML platforms like Google AI Platform, AWS SageMaker, or Azure Machine Learning for model development and deployment.
• Data Analytics and Big Data Technologies:
• Proficient in big data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, and Kafka for handling large datasets.
• Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik for deriving actionable insights from data.
• Programming Languages:
• Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, and SQL, crucial for data manipulation and algorithm development.
• Familiarity with Java or Scala can be advantageous for integration with enterprise systems.
• Cloud Computing Platforms:
• In-depth knowledge of cloud computing environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, particularly their AI and data analytics services.
• Database Management:
• Experience with database management and querying tools, including traditional SQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra).
• DevOps and MLOps:
• Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) for efficient deployment of AI solutions.
• Understanding of MLOps principles to streamline the machine learning lifecycle from experimentation to production.
• Legal-Tech Software:
• Exposure to legal-tech software and platforms is beneficial, as it provides contextual understanding crucial for application in the legal domain.
• Security and Compliance Tools:
• Knowledge of security protocols and compliance standards relevant to data privacy and AI ethics, especially in the legal sector.
• Collaboration and Project Management Tools:
• Proficiency in using project management and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Asana, Trello) to manage AI/ML projects efficiently.
• Emerging Technologies:
• Keen interest and understanding of emerging technologies in AI, such as natural language processing, computer vision, and predictive analytics, to stay ahead in the field.

job_description:
About the Organization

Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. Redhorse specializes in developing and implementing creative strategies and solutions with private, state, and federal customers in the areas of cultural and environmental resources services, climate and energy change, information technology, and intelligence services. We are hiring creative, motivated, and talented people with a passion for doing what's right, what's smart, and what works.

Position Description

Redhorse Corporation is actively seeking an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Enterprise Functional Specialist (FS) Subject Matter Expert (SME) to join the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office (CDAO) to bring increased artificial intelligence capability to the Defense Intelligence Enterprise (DIE). The AI Enterprise FS/SME will be a high performing individual who desires to work on the cutting edge of AI and deep learning and make a transformational difference to the DIE. The contractor will be experienced operating within fast-paced, challenging, multi-faceted projects that include diverse teams of performers, including technical, financial, analytical, and managerial background.

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:
• Providing insight and advice concerning strategic direction and applicability of industry standard solutions.
• Providing high level vision to influence complex milestones to accomplish program objectives.
• Providing specific expertise in support of the creation of comprehensive methods for describing current and future strategic milestones of the project.
• Overseeing major functions, disciplines, or segments of a program relating to resources and network architecture and design, database planning and design, systems analysis, engineering, network services, conversion and implementation support, project management, data management, and other business, engineering, and information technology related services.
• Planning all aspects of project performance including full responsibility for long-range planning. Utilizing functional area expertise gained through direct industry experience to assess the operational and functional baseline of an organization and its critical components. Working with senior managers and executives to provide industry vision and strategic direction regarding the enterprise. Guiding the determination of information technology inadequacies and/or deficiencies that affect the functional area’s ability to support/meet organizational goals.
• Generating functional area strategies for enhanced Information Technology (IT) operations in a cross-functional area mode throughout the organization. Participating in account strategy sessions, strategic assessments and design reviews to validate enterprise approach and associated work products. Coordinating resolution of highly complex problems, organizational dynamics and tasks, possessing ability to meet and operate under deadlines.
• Overseeing plans for automated data processing systems from project inception to conclusion. Analyzing user needs to determine requirements and conducts feasibility studies. Identifying resources required for each task. Supervising a large support staff and/or serve as liaison to client staff. Providing strategic guidance to other technical staff in areas such as specifications, architectures, and information system design. Researching developments in field of expertise and applying them to the client environment, including emerging technologies, lessons learned, best practices, and assessment methodologies. Interfacing with client personnel at all organizational levels. Developing white papers and system documentation. Converting functional specifications to technical specifications.
• Providing professional support in conducting Federal acquisition management to include: acquisition planning assistance, including market research and recommending procurement strategy; acquisition document development, including cost/price estimates, quality assurance surveillance plans, statements of work, synopses, and solicitations. Providing expert assistance in supporting proposal evaluations, including price/cost analysis or technical proposal analysis; contract administration support services, including assistance with reviewing contractor performance, developing contract modifications, and investigating reports of contract discrepancies; contract close-out assistance. Knowledge of intellectual property licensing is preferred.

Basic Minimum Requirements for Skills, Experience, Education and Credentials include:
• US citizenship with an active Department of Defense (DoD) Top Secret (TS) security clearance and a current access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) (TS/SCI) is required. Applicants who are not US Citizens and who do not have a current and active TS/SCI security clearance will not be considered for this role.
• Master’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, STEM or computer science/engineering with 5 years of experience in any combination of military/government/civilian, or contractor experience with Government or DoD or Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, STEM or computer science/engineering with 8 years of experience in any combination of military/government/civilian, or contractor experience with Government or DoD is required
• DoD-wide knowledge and experience in one or more of the following areas: Bridging the gap between Warfighter requirements and commercial technology, artificial intelligence work, engineering and integration, acquisition lifecycle and management, medium altitude or high altitude ISR, test & evaluation, captured enemy materials, and/or publicly available information/social media, is highly desired.

job_description:
Outlier is a platform that connects subject matter experts to help build the world’s most advanced Generative AI. You will work on a variety of projects from generating training data in your discipline to advance these models to evaluating performance of models.

As an Remote Online Math Teacher for AI, you'll rate, review, and rewrite responses from AI models to enhance their accuracy, just as a teacher would for a student. No prior AI experience is needed. You'll join a community of teachers & experts working on the intersection of math & AI. This is a 100% fully remote opportunity where you'll enjoy a flexible choose-your-own-schedule with incredible work-life balance, all from the comfort of your own home.

Required: No prior AI experience is needed but candidates must be enrolled or completed enrollment in a mathematics or related program, or have relevant experience.

Shape the next generation of AI with your Math expertise.

Earnings:
• Hourly rate: up to $50 per hour USD, depending on your level of expertise

About the Opportunity:
• Cutting-edge projects: Work on interesting projects that push the boundaries of AI technology
• Flexibility: Set your own hours, 100% remote opportunity. Some work ~2-5hrs a week, others 40hrs a week.
• Weekly payouts: Get paid conveniently on a weekly basis
• Professional growth: Gain valuable AI experience while honing your writing skills and deepening your domain expertise
• Collaborative environment: Join a team of talented professionals who share your passion for AI
• Duration: Variable depending on project length, flexible hours
• Location: Remote from any of the following countries United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, and Argentina.

Responsibilities:
• Train AI models by creating and answering questions related to your field
• Evaluate and rank responses generated by AI
• Leverage your domain expertise to assess the factuality and relevance of text produced by AI models

Qualifications:
• Minimum: Junior or Senior undergraduates enrolled in a mathematics or related program
• Preferred: Graduate student, Master, PhD, or equivalent proficiency in mathematics or a related-field
• Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
• Attention to detail and ability to spot errors or inconsistencies in writing
• Able to verify educational & professional Information via our partner, Checkr

Nice to Have:
• Professional writing experience as a researcher, journalist, technical writer, editor, or similar roles
• Solid subject matter knowledge in other Math subfields
• Interest in AI and machine learning concepts

Additional Note:

This is a freelance position that is paid on a per-hour basis. We don’t offer internships as this is a freelance role. You also must be authorized to work in your country of residence, and we will not be providing sponsorship since this is a 1099 contract opportunity. However, if you are an international student, you may be able to sign up if you are on a visa. You should contact your tax/immigration advisor with specific questions regarding your circumstances. We are unable to provide any documentation supporting employment at this time. Please be advised that compensation rates may differ for non-US locations.

Base pay is determined by multiple factors, including the area of expertise, years of experience, and skillset needed for the project. Pay rates vary during the project lifecycle. For example, rates for onboarding are lower.

Outlier is a platform that connects subject matter experts to help build the world’s most advanced Generative AI. You will work on a variety of projects from generating training data in your discipline to advance these models to evaluating performance of models.

As an AI Math Specialist, you'll rate, review, and rewrite responses from AI models to enhance their accuracy, all from the comfort of your own home. No prior AI experience is needed. Work is intellectually challenging. You'll join a community of experts working on the intersection of math & AI. This is a 100% fully remote opportunity where you'll enjoy a flexible choose-your-own-schedule with incredible work-life balance.

Required: No prior AI experience is needed but candidates must be enrolled or completed enrollment in a mathematics or related program.

Shape the next generation of AI with your Math expertise.

Earnings:
• Hourly rate: up to $50 per hour USD, depending on your level of expertise

About the Opportunity:
• Cutting-edge projects: Work on interesting projects that push the boundaries of AI technology
• Flexibility: Set your own hours, 100% remote opportunity. Some work ~2-5hrs a week, others 40hrs a week.
• Weekly payouts: Get paid conveniently on a weekly basis
• Professional growth: Gain valuable AI experience while honing your writing skills and deepening your domain expertise
• Collaborative environment: Join a team of talented professionals who share your passion for AI
• Duration: Variable depending on project length, flexible hours
• Location: Remote from any of the following countries United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, and Argentina.

Responsibilities:
• Train AI models by creating and answering questions related to your field
• Evaluate and rank responses generated by AI
• Leverage your domain expertise to assess the factuality and relevance of text produced by AI models

Qualifications:
• Minimum: Junior or Senior undergraduates enrolled in a mathematics or related program
• Preferred: Graduate student, Master, PhD, or equivalent proficiency in mathematics or a related-field
• Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
• Attention to detail and ability to spot errors or inconsistencies in writing
• Able to verify educational & professional Information via our partner, Checkr

Nice to Have:
• Professional writing experience as a researcher, journalist, technical writer, editor, or similar roles
• Solid subject matter knowledge in other Math subfields
• Interest in AI and machine learning concepts

Additional Note:

This is a freelance position that is paid on a per-hour basis. We don’t offer internships as this is a freelance role. You also must be authorized to work in your country of residence, and we will not be providing sponsorship since this is a 1099 contract opportunity. However, if you are an international student, you may be able to sign up if you are on a visa. You should contact your tax/immigration advisor with specific questions regarding your circumstances. We are unable to provide any documentation supporting employment at this time. Please be advised that compensation rates may differ for non-US locations.

Base pay is determined by multiple factors, including the area of expertise, years of experience, and skillset needed for the project. Pay rates vary during the project lifecycle. For example, rates for onboarding are lower.

PLEASE NOTE: We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data.

job_description:
About This Opportunity

Are you a sales data scientist or machine learning sales engineer who enjoys solving real-world problems by applying cutting edge Gen AI/ML algorithms? Are you passionate about working with customers to solve their business challenges? Can you explain complex machine learning concepts in simple business terms? If the answer is “yes”, then we are looking for you!

As a Senior Sales Engineer you will become an integral part of the North America Solutions Engineering team responsible for working with a wide range of customers and prospects across multiple industries and verticals. This role is based in the DC Metro area. You will spend 50% of your time in this area so being in a close location is necessary.

You will be responsible for technical sales activities required to support attainment of new and expansion revenue for H2O.ai sales. As part of that, you will be a key technical advisor to H2O.ai customers and prospects:
• Being a trusted advisor and go to resource of all technical Gen AI/ML challenges during the sales process
• Providing machine learning expertise to help customers solve their business challenges
• Selling and architecting value-based AI solutions that address customer needs and leverage Cloud native technologies for scalability and efficiency

What You Will Do
• Be the trusted data science advisor for our prospects, customers and partners.
• Own account-related technical items and relationships - account planning, project management, and solution design
• Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to a diverse audience, including: engineers, business people, partners and executives to demonstrate thought leadership. Audiences will be large and small, and interactions will be in-person and online.
• Translate business use cases and requirements into value based technical solutions through the architecture of machine learning workflows and systems from data ingestion to model deployment
• Demonstrate machine learning solutions with engaging storytelling and technical accuracy
• Create, design, and deliver compelling presentations on complex and technical concepts
• Lead successful proof of values and concepts
• Keep track of customer projects and provide technical support for successful delivery whenever necessary.

What We Are Looking For
• Bachelor’s or a higher degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, or other quantitative disciplines and/or equivalent experience
• Minimum of 2 years of relevant sales engineering experience working in the field of Gen AI/ML, in a pre- sales customer facing role.
• Strong knowledge of Python programming and familiarity with various data munging and machine learning libraries is required
• Consultative selling experience is an asset
• In depth understanding of machine learning algorithms and experience applying Gen AI/ML to solve real work problems, including deployment of end to end ML pipelines
• Experience with Cloud platform architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP) and working knowledge of Kubernetes
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Self-starter, able to work without any supervision
• Comfortable with traveling up to 50%

Why H2O.ai?
• Market Leader in Total Rewards
• Remote-Friendly Culture
• Flexible working environment
• Be part of a world-class team
• Career Growth

H2O.ai is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status or any other legally protected basis.

H2O.ai is an innovative AI cloud platform company, leading the mission to democratize AI for everyone. Thousands of organizations from all over the world have used our cutting-edge technology across a variety of industries. We’ve made it easy for people at all levels to generate breakthrough solutions to complex business problems and advance the discovery of new ideas and revenue streams. We push the boundaries of what is possible with artificial intelligence.

H2O.ai employs the world’s top Kaggle Grandmasters, the community of best-in-the-world machine learning practitioners and data scientists. A strong AI for Good ethos and responsible AI drive the company’s purpose.

Please visit www.H2O.ai to learn more.
